title: Dune It Right
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Brand New Construction - Elevator - Private Pool/Spa (Heating available for an additional $60 per day during the months of Oct 31-May 1) - Outdoor Kitchen - 6 Adult Bikes & 6 seater Golf Cart - Convenient Beach Access Welcome to your next unforgettable getaway. This brand-new construction home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and serene privacy, backing up to a beautiful nature preserve and featuring a custom wall and fencing around the pool area for total seclusion. Step inside and discover stunning designer finishes, spacious living areas, and convenient elevator access to every floor. Multiple oversized balconies provide quiet spots to relax with your morning coffee or unwind after a day at the beach. Outdoors, enjoy a true resort experience with your private heated pool and spa, expansive patio, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, perfect for cookouts and evening gatherings. For exploring the area, take advantage of the 6 adult bikes and 6-seater golf cart included with your stay, along with easy beach access just moments away. The home’s quiet, peaceful setting offers the ideal escape, while still keeping you close to everything the coast has to offer. With parking for up to 5 vehicles, this home is designed for families and groups seeking high-end comfort in a tranquil, natural setting. Sleeping Arrangement First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Two Twin over Twin Bunkroom, Shared Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Separate Jr King Master Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Two Twin over Twin Bunkroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower/Tub Combo
